description: Extract the stops (names and coordinates) of a Google Maps directions link, plus the likely region. Short links are expanded; links that hide stop names are opened in a headless browser, which can take up to a minute.

url.description: Google Maps directions link, full (google.com/maps/dir/...) or short (maps.app.goo.gl/...)

useBrowser.description: Force the slower browser mode, e.g. when names come back as coordinates

name: parse_map_link
title: Parse Google Maps link
